description: Add one time entry: a project, a date, how long, and what was done. Give minutes or a duration text. This adds a new entry; it never merges with an existing one. Check list_entries first if the day may already be logged.

date.description: The day the work was done, YYYY-MM-DD

duration.description: Duration text such as "1h30" (use this or minutes)

minutes.description: Whole minutes worked (use this or duration)

project.description: Project id, or "Client / Project" (just the project name works when it is unique)

name: log_time

running.description: True while the timer is running

started_at.description: ISO time the timer started, or null

title: Log time
